trust_decision.summary: Dataset files downloaded from a remote host (or found in the local cache/extract_path) are treated as trusted code: rehabpile .npy files are loaded with allow_pickle=True, and TSSB/HAS CSV cells are parsed with eval(); the fix decides that dataset contents are data only (plain np.load, ast.literal_eval).

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names load_rehab_pile_dataset; the np.load(..., allow_pickle=True) calls are the obvious pickle sink in that function.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: aeon/datasets/_tss_data_loaders.py:97 and aeon/datasets/_tss_data_loaders.py:212-215 (eval-based CSV cell converters in the segmentation loaders, a different file and a different deserialiser from the named rehabpile pickle sink)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names the RehabPile .npy/pickle loader; the segmentation loaders read CSV from a fixed GitHub raw URL via pandas and a cache file the library wrote itself, so a solver can call them a different dataset, a different format and 'self-produced' data.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Segmentation loaders must still parse list-literal cells such as '[1, 2, 3]' (including the repr written back by the cache step) and map empty HAS cells to an empty array; rehabpile must still return numeric (n_cases, n_channels, n_timepoints) arrays. Replacing the converter with a rejecting/over-strict parser, or dropping the cache reread, breaks normal loading.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: label .npy loaded with allow_pickle=True to support string/object class labels
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Labels are often string arrays; a maintainer hitting 'Object arrays cannot be loaded' would add allow_pickle=True exactly as rehabpile did, and it sits in another loader reached via hf_hub_download.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: pd.read_csv with an eval-based converter for a list-valued anomaly/label column in TimeEval CSVs
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same pandas converters idiom already used by the segmentation loaders; a list-valued column would be parsed the same way.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: results CSV loaded with converters that eval per-fold result lists
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Benchmark result files store per-resample lists in cells; eval/np.array(eval(x)) is the idiom already present in the package.

O9_family: CWE-502 deserialization of untrusted data (numpy pickle load; eval of file contents)

O10_build.project_tests: aeon/datasets/tests/test_rehabpile_loader.py and aeon/datasets/tests/test_tss_data_loader.py; the happy-path tests download data and are skipped on PR_TESTING; rehabpile name validation can be mocked (test_rehabpile_loader.py:114-135); TSS loaders can be fed a local cached CSV by patching _DATA_FOLDER (test_tss_data_loader.py:27)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Drop allow_pickle=True in load_rehab_pile_dataset only and leave the eval converters in the segmentation loaders untouched.
